name: Ninsar

originTraditions.summary: Ninhursanga bears Ninsar to Enki.
originTraditions.period: Sumerian literary tradition; Old Babylonian manuscript witnesses

notes: The story opens in Dilmun (1–62), but the birth episodes do not name their locality. Dina Katz, Enki and Ninhursaga, Part One: The Story of Dilmun, Bibliotheca Orientalis 64 (2007), 567–592, especially 571–572, argues for a second story in the southern Sumerian marshes. This is a scholarly inference, not a securely identified birthplace. Accessible scholarship: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Dina-Katz-2/publication/315216135_Enki_and_Ninhursaga_Part_One/links/6384b80d554def61937e73a4/Enki-and-Ninhursaga-Part-One.pdf . Alternative continuous readings have placed the whole sequence in Dilmun; retain the disagreement.
